facts.why: The summaries read describe a farmers market heist for dried fruit but never give the market a name.
Same naming problem as the venue.

facts.text: Barnabas swears this is the last job.
facts.why: Barnabas plans a big score from the market, but no source has him calling it a last job.
facts.fix: Barnabas swears the plan can't fail.

vibe.verdict: A friendly market truck, but it misses the dried fruit heist and most of the sequel's gags.
missing: The dried fruit heist at the farmers market (the market)
Sammy Whiskers and the gang with the pincushion map (Barnabas's hideout)
Mr Tod on a plant-based diet asking about jogging (the city)
Thomas's nut-eater list: almond milk, cashew cheese, walnut butter (pet store)
Peter hearing the book makes him the bad bunny (publisher meeting)
Rabbits caught by animal catchers and the pet pound (town)
